description: Repo-scale: deactivating a user (new PATCH /users/{id}) must block them as a task assignee (both on create and reassignment) AND as a new project owner - 3 call sites
prompts: Add `PATCH /users/{id}` (new `UserUpdate` schema, currently just `is_active: bool | None`) so a user can be deactivated. Once a user is inactive, they must be rejected everywhere they could be attached to new work - this spans three separate call sites: (1) `POST /tasks` when `assignee_id` targets them, (2) `PATCH /tasks/{id}` when `assignee_id` is changed to them, and (3) `POST /projects` when `owner_id` targets them. All three must reject with a 400 if the referenced user exists and is inactive; a nonexistent user id should not be treated specially here (leave that to existing 404 behavior elsewhere).

reference_solution.app/schemas/user.py:
from __future__ import annotations

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict


class UserBase(BaseModel):
    username: str
    email: str
    full_name: str = ""


class UserCreate(UserBase):
    pass


class UserUpdate(BaseModel):
    is_active: bool | None = None


class UserOut(UserBase):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)

    id: int
    is_active: bool
